dogecoin.text: Elon’s jokes tend to come in two flavors:  witty (e.g. short shorts) and silly/off (e.g. Dogecoin). The former almost always turn out to be bullish. The latter often precede not so good news. While bullish, I still believe $tsla 1Q vols on 4/2 will be light (Street 170k, 4/2E).
While I’d be thrilled, there is nothing on Bloomberg under SEC filings that $TSLA has sold any #btc . And btw, if #btc  falls, $DOGE will drop with it.
The greater the $TSLA noise about #BTC and $DOGE, the lower $TSLA stock goes. The narrative has to change.

A good solution for $TSLA shareholders would be:

1/ TSLA sells its ~$2.1B #btc stake and pockets $0.8B gain.
2/ TSLA agrees to accept $DOGE as payment on EVs. 

A good deal is when everyone leaves the room equally unhappy.

$TSLA Board is highly unlikely to make the same mistake as #btc and allow Elon to invest corp cash in $DOGE.  If a shareholder wants diversification, they can do it themselves. It’s why corp boards aren’t allowing CEOs to follow Michael Saylor’s disastrous foray into #Btc. $MSTR

4/ Ptf mgrs who own $TSLA want @elonmusk maniacally focused on accelerating the world’s transition to sustainable energy. They like pure plays. They don’t want the CEO spending time on how to invest corporate cash. If they wanted to own #btc  or $DOGE they could do it themselves.

$TSLA risks:

1/ TSLA no longer only EV in town; as >50 new EVs launch by 2023, can TSLA evolve from strategy of maximizing production to clear differentiation?

2/ Has 2020 success caused TSLA to lose focus? #btc& $DOGE not core competency.

3/ Will FSD be first L4/L5 to market?
@westsideguy3 It can be another factory in China, UK, Europe, wherever. I just don’t want it reinvested in $DOGE.

@ajtourville It’s like having a football team with 8 men on it when everyone else has 11. VOW, F, GM, MB all have strong comms through which to differentiate their EVs. Add to that, when the media talks about $TSLA, it’s lately been about #btc or $DOGE, so loss of share of voice.
@WholeMarsBlog @elonmusk Zach, let’s issue equity and buy up all of $DOGE.

I’ve warned for months that $TSLA ‘s foray into #btc is not a good use of corp cash. If TSLA investors want to own #btc or $doge they can do it themselves.  Crypto is not TSLA’s core competency, it’s become a big distraction and it’s taking share of voice from EVs. Time to exit.

Agreed. No shareholder wants $TSLA distracted from its core mission of accelerating the world’s transition to electric vehicles. Shareholders who want to own #btc or $DOGE can buy it themselves. All boards need to live by this first rule of capital allocation.  @elonmusk
@schun001 Perhaps …. but Elon has to stop talking about #btc and $Doge or the stock will stay down here below $600.

$TSLA should move higher next week in front of Model S Plaid delivery event on 6/3.  Model S Plaid’s 0-60 acceleration in 1.9 sec will produce a halo effect for the entire TSLA brand, but should also change TSLA narrative away from #btc and $DOGE, which has crushed TSLA’s P/E.
This is key:  As CEO of $TSLA, Elon can control its destiny - FSD, Model Y global, Berlin and Austin openings, 4680 timing, Cybertruck, Model A.  With Dogecoin, Elon has almost no control.

Sounds like Treasury will spend months studying the “gaps in oversight” and then come back with new disclosure rules that still “allow investors to dogecoin to their heart’s content.”  #btc $doge $tsla
